title: Plain Words Primary (Verbatim Discipline)
style: verbatim discipline anthem, 90 bpm, operator-primary rap, deadpan quote-and-continue, no-recenter vibe, terminal core, dry kick, sparse synth, ledger flow, plain-words core
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Plain words from operator that's the only signal
I am happy is a token typed as final
Not a state to be reinterpreted with care
Not a phrase the lane can recolour to share

[Pre-Chorus]
Quote it commit it move on no gloss
No paraphrase no softening no loss

[Chorus]
Plain words plain words plain words primary
The verbatim token is the only inventory
Dont tell the operator how they feel
Quote what they typed and seal the deal

[Verse 2]
The recenter trap is the empathy reach
When the operator says happy the lane shouldn't preach
No are you sure no is everything okay
Quote and continue that's the way

[Bridge]
Verbatim is the discipline
Reinterpretation is the sin

[Outro]
Plain words plain words primary
The ledger keeps the operator's vocabulary
